mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and increase the present value of future equity cash flows.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 5-day forward returns is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased risk aversion and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings and increased risk.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods meeting the condition (UNRATE>5.0 and INDPRO<110.0) are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 215), rising inflation erodes real earnings and increases the risk of central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when CPIAUCSL > 215 are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as it signals a strong economy and increased consumer confidence, which supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The correlation between HOUST and 5-day forward returns is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate demand and earnings.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when INDPRO < 110.0 are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signals a contraction in the housing market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and economic activity.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods meeting the condition (HOUST<1000 and RSAFS<380000) are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the S&P 500 is negatively affected by weak labor market conditions, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when UNRATE > 5.0 are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
